name: What is the process for cabinet repair with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for cabinet repair with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we assess the damage to your cabinets and discuss your repair needs. We then provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work and associated costs. Once approved, we schedule the repair at your convenience. Our skilled technicians will carefully execute the repairs, ensuring quality craftsmanship. We conclude with a final inspection to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, damage assessment, estimate, scheduling, repair, and final inspection.
